Ahri.summary: She is slippery and her charm is a real threat, but as a support she lacks the gold she needs and usually underperforms.

Alistar.summary: Bully him hard at level 1 before he can use his combo. Avoid getting caught by his headbutt-pulverize and you outscale him heavily; one of your best matchups.

Amumu.summary: His ult is a huge teamfight tool, but its long cooldown gives you many windows to force fights with your own ult while his is down.

Annie.summary: Mage supports like Annie are immobile, which makes them easy ult targets, and they cannot burst you once you have one or two items.

Ashe.summary: An Ashe support is a very favorable draft for you; just play normally.

Blitzcrank.summary: Dangerous if you or your ADC cannot dodge his hook; he punishes your roams and zones your ADC well. With confident movement the lane is manageable.

Brand.summary: Learn his skillshot habits and avoid eating everything and the lane is easy. Your ult gives free picks or forces Flashes whenever it is up.

Braum.summary: His shield stops your Q from passing through to stun a second target or wall. If his passive stacks on you alongside an aggressive ADC like Lucian or Samira, you can die quickly.

Galio.summary: Respect his CC early or you can die. From level 6 he can follow your roams with his ult. Keep your distance early and you outscale him, much like against Alistar.

Janna.summary: A skill matchup: a good Janna is hard to catch and peels very well, making engages difficult and trading tough. A weak Janna dies whenever you land a stun or ult.

Karma.summary: One of the hardest lanes: her empowered Q bullies you and her empowered E scales into fights and makes landing your spells difficult. The author considers her worth banning.

Leona.summary: Even with Unflinching she can kill you early. Survive laning and she becomes far less useful than you.

Lulu.summary: She bullies you in lane and scales equally well, and her speed boosts make your ult hard to land. Worth banning.

Lux.summary: An immobile mage; trust your dodging and hope your ADC dodges well too.

Maokai.summary: Very hard: you cannot win brush control against his saplings, his W engage is reliable, and his ult peels for his team or counters your ult engages.

Milio.summary: His E shield and passive let him win lane trades, and his range and attack speed buffs scale well. He can cleanse your stun off allies, though not your ult's stasis.

MissFortune.summary: Like Ashe support, a favorable draft for you.

Morgana.summary: Her Black Shield counters your whole kit, blocking both your stun and ult, especially if she maxes it first. If your Q breaks the shield, the stun still lands. Worth banning.

Nami.summary: Her W trades bully you in lane, but she scales less than other enchanters, so stay patient.

Nautilus.summary: Like Leona: avoid being chain-CC'd and killed early, then you outscale. His ult is slow and obvious, so your ult can negate it.

Pantheon.summary: A weak support pick, essentially a lesser Leona or Nautilus.

Poppy.summary: A cheesy early pick with good tools against you: tunnelling often lines you up for her stun, and her W blocks your tunnel. Easy to die early, but you outscale.

Pyke.summary: His hook is hard to dodge since he can hold it, and watch for a level 1-2 E-Flash engage. If he does not snowball ult resets you outscale, though vision control gets hard once he finishes Umbral Glaive.

Rakan.summary: Slippery and rarely catchable. With Xayah the 2v2 is strong, but with others you can bully him. His W knockup becomes easy to dodge with practice.

Rell.summary: Bully her hard in lane. After she commits W she is an easy target for you and your ADC; avoid clumping with allies so she gets no free engage.

Renata.summary: Squishy and immobile early but with unique outplay tools. Your tankiness makes her W revive hard to trigger off you, and you can ult yourself like a Zhonya's while her ally dies again.

Senna.summary: She struggles into ranged supports. Deny her free souls in lane and she becomes an immobile target for your ult.

Seraphine.summary: Very annoying and she outranges you, making trades hard. From level 6 you can start making plays; do not line up with teammates when her ult is up and stay patient.

Sona.summary: She outranges your autos, so be patient until level 6. She is very squishy, so any CC you land should be lethal.

Soraka.summary: Take Ignite and avoid small trades; either commit for the kill or do not trade, since she out-sustains you. Dodge her Qs and wait for level 6.

Swain.summary: A mage support you handle well, but his E snare hitbox can be deceptive, so give it room.

TahmKench.summary: Still a strong laner, but since his devour became his ult he is much worse at stopping your picks. You can bully him fairly hard early.

Taric.summary: Walk perpendicular as soon as he throws his stun and it will miss unless he Flashes. Your ult can neutralize his invulnerability window.

Thresh.summary: One of your worst lanes: his lantern saves anyone you try to ult, and you can die quickly to a hook or flay. Worth banning.

Velkoz.summary: An immobile mage; avoid eating every skillshot and you win.

Xerath.summary: An immobile mage; avoid his skillshots and you win.

Yuumi.summary: She cannot follow your roams or punish your ADC while you are away, but if an ally of hers gets fed you cannot stop them. If she detaches as your Q lands, she can stun herself.

Zilean.summary: His speed boosts and revive are strong anti-pick tools against you; you largely rely on the Zilean being weak. He is rare, so the author does not consider him ban-worthy.

Zyra.summary: An immobile mage; dodge her skillshots and you win.
